hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *databricks.yml|*/resources/*.yml|*/resources/*.yaml) (cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && databricks bundle validate --profile free-edition 2>&1) ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" || exit 0; uvx ruff format --config pyproject.toml "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; uvx ruff check --config pyproject.toml --fix --quiet "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; remaining="$(uvx ruff check --config pyproject.toml "$f" 2>&1)"; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "$remaining" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; [ -d "$root/app/frontend/node_modules" ] || exit 0; out="$(cd "$root/app/frontend" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1)"; if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac; }

git diff --cached 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'BEGIN (RSA|OPENSSH|EC) PRIVATE KEY|DATABRICKS_CLIENT_SECRET *=|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|dapi[0-9a-f]{32}' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Secret-shaped content detected in staged diff (private key / AKIA / ghp_ / dapi token pattern). Review before committing."}}' || exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Scanning staged diff for secret-shaped content...

hooks.command:
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)"; cd "$ROOT" || exit 0; PYTEST=".venv/bin/pytest"; [ -x "$PYTEST" ] || PYTEST="python3 -m pytest"; backend_out="$($PYTEST -q 2>&1)"; backend_rc=$?; frontend_out=""; frontend_rc=0; if [ -d app/frontend/node_modules ]; then frontend_out="$(npm --prefix app/frontend run -s test 2>&1)"; frontend_rc=$?; fi; if [ $backend_rc -ne 0 ] || [ $frontend_rc -ne 0 ]; then msg="Tests are failing — fix them, or explain to the user why not, before ending the turn."; if [ $backend_rc -ne 0 ]; then msg="$(printf '%s

pytest (exit %s):
%s' "$msg" "$backend_rc" "$(printf '%s' "$backend_out" | tail -c 3000)")"; fi; if [ $frontend_rc -ne 0 ]; then msg="$(printf '%s

npm test (exit %s):
%s' "$msg" "$frontend_rc" "$(printf '%s' "$frontend_out" | tail -c 3000)")"; fi; jq -n --arg msg "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"Stop",continueConversation:true,systemMessage:$msg}}'; fi; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Running the test suite before ending the turn...
